extracted.name: Zesty Spinach Salad Dressing
extracted.description: Spinach salad dressing with just the right amount of vinegar, mustard, and pepper is a zesty addition to your greens.
instruction_lines: Combine canola oil, vinegar, garlic, sugar, dry mustard, salt, and black pepper in a jar with a tight-fitting lid; cover and shake thoroughly. Refrigerate until flavors blend, about 1 hour.
